overview: The Council passed resolutions supporting the state Fair Share Amendment and a commission on Haitian descent, while referring discussions on tenant protections and after-school programming to subcommittees. An ordinance banning polystyrene food containers also passed its first reading.

items.title: Honoring Bill Mazaica
items.summary: Approved a resolution honoring Bill Mazaica for 47.5 years of service to Medford Public Schools upon his retirement.

items.title: Support for Fair Share Amendment
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting the proposed state constitutional amendment to tax annual income above $1 million for education and transportation funding.

items.title: Commission on the Status of Citizens of Haitian Descent
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting Senate Bill 1819 to establish a statewide commission to address issues facing the Haitian American community.

items.title: Mystic to Minuteman Bikeway Survey
items.summary: Approved a resolution to inform residents about a survey regarding pedestrian and multimodal path improvements connecting the Mystic River to the Minuteman Bikeway.

items.title: Auburn Street Shared Use Path
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to report on establishing a shared use path on Auburn Street in partnership with the City of Somerville.

items.title: Housing Stability and Tenant Protections
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Housing Subcommittee to discuss drafting home rule petitions for rent stabilization, tenant right to purchase, and eviction protections. Councilors and residents debated the necessity of these tools following recent mass displacements at a Bradley Road apartment building.

items.title: Polystyrene Food Container Ban
items.summary: Approved on first reading an ordinance banning the use of polystyrene food containers by food service establishments, with implementation set for July 2023. Discussion focused on the environmental and health benefits versus the potential financial burden on small businesses and large food processors.

items.title: After-school Programming Needs
items.summary: Referred a discussion regarding the high demand and lack of capacity for after-school programming to the Recreation and Youth Affairs Subcommittee.

items.title: Green Line Extension Planning and Parking
items.summary: Approved a request for an update on development planning and potential parking policy changes in South Medford in preparation for the Green Line Extension opening.

items.title: Boston Marathon and First Responder Recognition
items.summary: Approved a resolution wishing luck to Medford residents running the 2022 Boston Marathon and recognized first responders for EMS Dispatch Week.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved committee reports concerning the Science Subcommittee and a Committee of the Whole meeting regarding snow removal ordinances.
